def factor_overnight_intraday_dissonance_ewm(df):
    """Exponentially smoothed signed square-root dissonance between overnight and intraday returns."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight, intraday = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    overnight = overnight.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    intraday = intraday.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    signed_sqrt_overnight = np.sign(overnight) * np.sqrt(np.abs(overnight))
    signed_sqrt_intraday = np.sign(intraday) * np.sqrt(np.abs(intraday))
    raw_dissonance = signed_sqrt_overnight - signed_sqrt_intraday
    factor = raw_dissonance.ewm(span=5, adjust=False, min_periods=1).mean()
    df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_dissonance_ewm"] = factor.fillna(0.0)
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_dissonance_ewm"]
description: Preserves the parent's overnight-intraday dissonance mechanism, which captures disagreement between overnight/global information and intraday/local trading. The parent's 5-day simple moving average treats all recent dissonance equally; this mutation switches to an exponentially weighted moving average (span=5) to give more weight to recent observations, improving responsiveness to regime changes while retaining the core signed-square-root economic signal. The ewm uses only past observations, and the factor remains continuous and interpretable without cross-sectional transformation.
